_schema_note: v14 schema. date is the calendar date (America/New_York) this cache was computed for, YYYY-MM-DD. tickers.<TICKER> fields: rsi (T-1 daily RSI-14), ma20, ma_50d, ma_20d_prev (MA20 as of ma20_slope_lookback_days trading days ago, for slope check), atr_20d, pct_from_high, t1_close, t1_low_5d_min / t1_low_5d_min_prev (min close of the most recent 5 trading days and the 5 before that, for Higher Low confirmation), ma_5d, t1_volume, vol_20ma (20-day average volume, for volume-expansion confirmation), next_earnings_date (YYYY-MM-DD or null), generated_at (timestamp this cache entry was actually computed, ISO8601 with -04:00/-05:00 offset), market_date (trading date this cache reflects), source (e.g. robinhood_historicals). Recomputed once per calendar date; reset to empty here since the field set changed from the pre-v14 schema and the cache is fully rebuildable from broker/market data per the Cache-Rebuildable invariant.
